abstract: Hollywood Reporter (June 4, 2026) on SAG-AFTRA membership ratification of a 4-year deal with the AMPTP (91.42% approve, 8.58% oppose, 19.25% turnout). Key AI protections: synthetic AI performers only allowed when providing 'significant additional value'; studios need an 'articulable business reason' to scan a performer for a digital replica; independently created digital replicas require minimum payments and residuals; digital replicas cannot be used to circumvent strike participation. Deal effective July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2030.
keyFindings: Synthetic AI performers require 'significant additional value' vs live performers
Studios need 'articulable business reason' to scan performers for digital replicas
Minimum payment rates and residuals apply to independently created digital replicas
Digital replicas cannot be used to circumvent strike participation
Minimum wage increases 3% annually; deal runs July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2030
methodology: Union ratification reporting; specifics from published contract summary.
qualifiers: Contract terms are legally binding within US SAG-AFTRA jurisdiction only. 'Significant additional value' is a subjective test that will be tested in future disputes. Overall a counter-displacement signal — union bargaining lifting AI floor.
